blurb: Diamond Dance Studio offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, contemporary/improv, lyrical, pom, and stretch & conditioning. They provide programs for all experience levels from beginners to nationally competitive performers. The studio emphasizes confidence, discipline, teamwork, and personal growth in a positive, family-oriented environment.
